content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization, which was REQUIRED at time of service. This payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review, so those paths are unavailable. An appeal already failed and there is no denial on the table to appeal further; resubmitting would just draw a duplicate/denial. Since the missing auth is a provider responsibility, the balance cannot be billed to the patient, leaving write-off as the only proper resolution.","action":"write_off"}
